grammar.title: Seeing in the New Year with 过年
grammar.explanation: 过年 (guònián) means "to celebrate the (Lunar) New Year" often used with 的时候 to talk about what happens during that time.

grammar.title: Freezing temperatures with 零下
grammar.explanation: 零下 (língxià) means "below zero" used with 度 (dù, degrees) to describe freezing temperatures: 零下五度 (minus five degrees).

sentences.en: During New Year, we go home.
How do you celebrate the New Year?
Let's celebrate the New Year together.

sentences.zh: 过年的时候，大家都很高兴。
sentences.pinyin: Guònián de shíhou, dàjiā dōu hěn gāoxìng.
sentences.en: During New Year, everyone is happy.

sentences.zh: 北方冬天常常零下十几度。
sentences.pinyin: Běifāng dōngtiān chángcháng língxià shí jǐ dù.
sentences.en: In the north, winters are often minus ten-something degrees.

sentences.pinyin: Wàibian língxià shí dù, hěn lěng.
sentences.en: It's minus ten outside, very cold.
Last night it was minus three degrees.

sentences.zh: 她从包里拿出了一本书。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cóng bāo lǐ ná chū le yī běn shū.
sentences.en: She took a book out of her bag.
